Rename for a client that does not ask first, and reads edits without
versions.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
driver_config: mud.dgd
-- lib/mud.dgd --
include_dirs = ({ "/include" });
-- lib/obj/a.c --
void create() {
    int n;
    n = 1;
}
-- script --
initialize plain lib
open lib/obj/a.c
rename lib/obj/a.c 2:4 count
shutdown
exit
